subject.title: heartbeat: activeHours start/end time strings skip validation when every is omitted (silently runs 24/7)

question: Should OpenClaw accept failing config load for previously accepted malformed heartbeat `activeHours` values when `heartbeat.every` is omitted, or require a doctor diagnostic first?
rationale: The fix matches the documented HH:MM contract, but stricter config validation is upgrade-sensitive because existing malformed configs can stop loading instead of being treated as permissive.

options.title: Accept stricter validation
options.body: Merge the linked schema fix as-is and own the fail-fast behavior for malformed active-hours config.

options.title: Require doctor diagnostic first
options.body: Ask for a doctor diagnostic or repair path before the schema starts rejecting these malformed existing configs.

recommendation.title: Accept stricter validation
recommendation.body: Merge the linked schema fix as-is and own the fail-fast behavior for malformed active-hours config.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current config/runtime history signal for the affected schema and compatibility choice.
